changes.why: v0.18.0 removed R.nthChar, deprecated since v0.16.0 (6c0ba86b 'remove functions deprecated in v0.16.0')
v0.18.0 removed R.nthCharCode, deprecated since v0.16.0 (6c0ba86b)

v0.18.0's commuteMap folds with reduceRight and prepend (1502c6d5, 7ef6df08), so the last list's element varies fastest: commuteMap(map(add(10)), of, [[1, 2], [3, 4]]) went from [[11, 13], [12, 13], [11, 14], [12, 14]] to [[11, 13], [11, 14], [12, 13], [12, 14]]
knock-on of commuteMap (commute = commuteMap(identity)): commute(of, [[1, 2], [3, 4]]) went from [[1, 3], [2, 3], [1, 4], [2, 4]] to [[1, 3], [1, 4], [2, 3], [2, 4]]
v0.18.0 makes converge binary (360d5904): converge(after, [f1, f2]) takes the branching functions as one list (converge(mult, add(1), add(3))(2) now throws), a pair here: the signature changes
v0.18.0 renamed isSet to allUniq (f28adc24) and made isSet its deprecated alias: the revealed body is allUniq(list), with the same results
new in v0.18.0 (@category List): isSet's code under the new name, no element occurring twice (R.equals)
new in v0.18.0 (@category List): pair(fst, snd) = [fst, snd], a pair here
new in v0.18.0 (@category Relation): eqBy(f, x, y) = equals(f(x), f(y))
new in v0.18.0 (@category Object): createMapEntry's code under the new name (de2cc7e6), {key: val}
new in v0.18.0 (@category Logic): when(pred, whenTrueFn, x) = pred(x) ? whenTrueFn(x) : x
new in v0.18.0 (@category Logic): unless(pred, whenFalseFn, x) = pred(x) ? x : whenFalseFn(x)
